name: Rivera household
text: Ground-floor apartment, no yard but a park across the street. I work from home 3 days, office 2 days (away ~9 hours those days). Live alone, no other pets. Had a dog growing up but never as an adult. Moderately active - I walk about 30 minutes a day.

name: Okafor family
text: House with a fenced yard. Two parents and kids aged 4 and 7. We already have a 6-year-old female lab mix. Both parents work; dog would be alone about 6 hours on weekdays. We've owned dogs for 15 years. We hike on weekends and walk the dog daily.

name: Chen couple
text: Third-floor condo, two adults, one 8-year-old calm male cat. We both work hybrid so someone is home most days. First kitten for us, but we've had cats for 10 years. Low-key household, we like quiet evenings.
